pairs: Igitur sors filiorum Judæ per cognationes suas ista fuit:
And so, the lot of the sons of Judah, by their families,
was this: from the border of Edom,
contra meridiem, et usque ad extremam partem australis plagæ.
to the desert of Sin toward the south, and even to the furthest part of the southern region.
Initium ejus a summitate maris salsissimi,
Its beginning was from the summit of the very salty sea,
And it extends toward the ascent of the Scorpion,
and it passes on to Sinai.
and it passes through to Hezron,
And from there, it passes on to Azmon,
and reaches to the torrent of Egypt.
And its boundary shall be the great sea;
this shall be the limit of the southern region.
mare salsissimum usque ad extrema Jordanis:
the beginning shall be the very salty sea, even to the limit of the Jordan,
et ea quæ respiciunt ad aquilonem,
and that which looks toward the north,
a lingua maris usque ad eumdem Jordanis fluvium.
from the bay of the sea, even to the same river Jordan.
And the border ascends into Beth-hoglah,
et transit ab aquilone in Beth Araba,
and it crosses from the north into Beth-Arabah,
ascendens ad lapidem Boën filii Ruben:
ascending to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben.
et tendens usque ad terminos Debera de valle Achor,
And it reaches as far as the borders of Debara, from the Valley of Achor,
to the north, looking toward Gilgal,
quæ est ex adverso ascensionis Adommim,
which is opposite the Ascent of Adummim,
on the southern part of the torrent.
transitque aquas, quæ vocantur fons solis:
And it crosses the waters that are called the Fountain of the Sun.
et erunt exitus ejus ad fontem Rogel.
And its exit shall be at the Fountain of Rogel.
Ascenditque per convallem filii Ennom ex latere Jebusæi ad meridiem,
And it ascends by the steep valley of the son of Hinnom, from the side of the Jebusite,
toward the south; this is Jerusalem.
et inde se erigens ad verticem montis,
And from there, it raises itself to the top of the mountain,
qui est contra Geennom ad occidentem in summitate vallis Raphaim contra aquilonem:
which is opposite Geennom to the west, at the top of the Valley of the Rephaim, to the north.
pertransitque a vertice montis usque ad fontem aquæ Nephtoa:
And it passes through, from the top of the mountain, even to the fountain of the Water of Nephtoah.
et pervenit usque ad vicos montis Ephron:
And it continues on, as far as the villages of mount Ephron.
Et circuit de Baala contra occidentem,
And it circles from Baalah, to the west,
transitque juxta latus montis Jarim ad aquilonem in Cheslon:
And it passes by the side of mount Jearim, to the north, into Chesalon.
and it passes through to Timnah.
Et pervenit contra aquilonem partis Accaron ex latere:
And it continues on, toward the north, to a region beside Ekron.
and it crosses to mount Baalah.
et magni maris contra occidentem fine concluditur.
and the last part closes at the west with the great sea.
Hi sunt termini filiorum Juda per circuitum in cognationibus suis.
These are the borders of the sons of Judah, in their families, on all sides.
Caleb vero filio Jephone dedit partem in medio filiorum Juda, sicut præceperat ei Dominus: Cariath Arbe patris Enac, ipsa est Hebron.
Yet truly, to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, he gave a portion in the midst of the sons of Judah, just as the Lord had instructed him: the City of Arba, the father of Anak, which is Hebron.
Delevitque ex ea Caleb tres filios Enac,
And Caleb destroyed from it the three sons of Anak, Sheshai,
Sesai et Ahiman et Tholmai de stirpe Enac.
and Ahiman, and Talmai, of the stock of Anak.
Atque inde conscendens venit ad habitatores Dabir,
And ascending further from there, he came to the inhabitants of Debir,
dabo ei Axam filiam meam uxorem.
I will give to him Achsah, my daughter, as wife.”
Cepitque eam Othoniel filius Cenez frater Caleb junior: deditque ei Axam filiam suam uxorem.
And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, the younger brother of Caleb, seized it. And he gave him Achsah, his daughter, as wife.
And as they were traveling together,
suasa est a viro suo ut peteret a patre suo agrum.
she was urged by her husband that she ask her father for a field.
And she sighed, as she was sitting on her donkey.
terram australem et arentem dedisti mihi;
You have given to me a southern and dry land;
join to it also a watered land.”
Dedit itaque ei Caleb irriguum superius et inferius.
And so Caleb gave to her the watered land above and below it.
Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Juda per cognationes suas.
This is the possession of the tribe of the sons of Judah, by their families.
Erantque civitates ab extremis partibus filiorum Juda juxta terminos Edom a meridie:
And the cities, from the furthest parts of the sons of Judah, beside the borders of Edom to the south,
were: Kabzeel and Eder and Jagur,
et Cyna et Dimona et Adada,
and Kinah and Dimonah and Adadah,
et Cades et Asor et Jethnam,
and Kadesh and Hazor and Ithnan,
et Asergadda et Hassemon et Bethphelet,
and Hazar-gaddah and Heshmon and Bethpelet,
et Hasersual et Bersabee et Baziothia,
and Hazar-shual and Beersheba and Biziothiah,
et Baala et Jim et Esem,
and Baalah and Iim and Ezem,
et Eltholad et Cesil et Harma,
and Eltolad and Chesil and Hormah,
et Siceleg et Medemena et Sensenna,
and Ziklag and Madmannah and Sansannah,
Lebaoth et Selim et Aën et Remon.
Lebaoth and Shilhim, and Ain and Rimmon.
et Zanoë et Ængannim et Taphua et Enaim,
and Zanoah and Engannim, and Tappuah and Enam,
et Saraim et Adithaim et Gedera et Gederothaim:
and Shaaraim and Adithaim, and Gederah and Gederothaim:
et Gideroth et Bethdagon et Naama et Maceda:
and Gederoth and Bethdagon, and Naamah and Makkedah:
et Ceila et Achzib et Maresa:
and Keilah and Achzib and Mareshah:
from Ekron, as far as the sea,
omnia quæ vergunt ad Azotum et viculos ejus.
all that inclines toward Ashdod, and its villages.
as far as the torrent of Egypt,
with the great sea as its border.
et Janum et Beththaphua et Apheca,
and Janim and Beth-Tappuah and Aphekah,
Maon et Carmel et Ziph et Jota,
Maon and Carmel, and Ziph and Juttah,
which is Kiriath-jearim, the City of Forests,
Jebusæum autem habitatorem Jerusalem non potuerunt filii Juda delere:
But the sons of Judah were not able to destroy the Jebusite inhabitants of Jerusalem.
habitavitque Jebusæus cum filiis Juda in Jerusalem usque in præsentem diem.
And so the Jebusite lived with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem, even to the present day.
